Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Salem wrote:
> LSJ wrote:
>> cro...@gmail.com wrote:
>
>>> Bestial Vengeance
>>> Requires a Laibon.
>>> [ani] Only usable before range is determined. Choose a retainer on
>>> this Laibon. This combat, this Laibon is immune to frenzy cards and
>>> the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution if the
>>> retainer is ready. A vampire can play only one Bestial Vengeance each
>>> combat.
>>> [ANI] As above, but for 2 damage.
>
> while we're on topic, if the opposing minion plays Bestial Vengeance,
> and as my strike i target the retainer with a strike that will kill it,
> do I still take the additional damage or not?

Strike resolution effects are simultaneous.
You take the damage at the same time the retainer does.

You won't take damage in the following rounds, however, since the retainer will
no longer be ready.

Of you could kill the retainer with first strike.

> the whole 'if the retainer is ready' bit and the timing with strike
> resolution has me a bit unclear. if the retainer was a murder of crows
> it would still do it's regular damage during strike resolution, and this
> is the same time, slightly before 'prevent damage'...i think....argh.
>
> in what instances would the 'if the retainer is ready' actually be
> required card text?

Burning the retainer => retainer is no longer ready.

Mask Empathy. Weather Control. Ranged strikes at long range targeting the
retainer. Body of Sun. Target Retainer.
